conventions.no_sort: short_candidates() does NOT sort; it preserves input row order. The app then filters collateral<=budget and sorts by (score or 0) descending (Python stable sort -> ties keep input order)
conventions.filters: require ann and delta non-None; CSP: put & strike<spot; CC: call & strike>spot; dmin<=|delta|<=dmax; MIN_DTE<=dte<=MAX_DTE (0..400 relaxed); credit >= MIN_CREDIT*100 = 5.0 (>=1.0 relaxed); spread_pct None or <= MAX_SPREAD_PCT 25 (skipped when relaxed)
conventions.relax_binding: in the app relax == (risk=='ALL'); scenario 13 shows relax=True combined with BALANCED deltas to expose the flag independently
